svg.title: Parabolic-trough solar plant — Linear collector field
svg.desc: Linear collector field. 6 equipment references and 6 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Linear collector field · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
